systems.country_label: Base de Données Spéciale des Ménages pauvres et/ou vulnérables Affectés par les Catastrophes (BDS-MAC)
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, Promotion of Decentralisation and Local Development
systems.tiers: national; fed by data supplied by administrative authorities and local authorities (regions, communes), among others

note: A decree of 15 October 2025 creating a national database of disaster-affected households; communes are named only as one supplier of data, with no means of transmission, connection or system at their offices stated.
